title: Landfall and Rivergate
author: August Nakamura
blurb: Paloma Whitlock, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
